Everyone! Watch out for the green claws![XENO:n ]
And the other ones' spears![XENO:wait wait=key ]
There's something different about them![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You catch on quick, boy.[XENO:n ]
You're right. These weapons are special.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

They were made especially to decompose[XENO:n ]
you Homs. No, wait, any being from Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
How can that be?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I dunno about all this technical stuff.[XENO:n ]
But it's something to do with that ether.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Ether is like the Giant God's blood.[XENO:n ]
The fortress sucks its blood out for us.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Then we use it to make this green liquid.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Pretty clever, don't you think?[XENO:wait wait=key ]
This world suits me just fine, Dunban![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Mumca! You're gonna pay![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I'm tired of your yapping, Mr Hero.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

I'm gonna squish you like a slug! Right here,[XENO:n ]
where we shared such lovely memories.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
